answers.supplier_relationship: I opened a trade account with Bright Wholesale Ltd in November 2025 after meeting them at the Spring Fair trade show. I have placed four orders with them since.
answers.items_genuine: Yes, genuine and I can evidence the chain
answers.complaint_reason: I listed the ASINs on 20 January 2026 using stock from an order I had not yet reconciled against a purchase order, so 20 of the units I sold came from an earlier mixed pallet I could not tie to a single invoice. I had no goods-in record linking each unit to a purchase order.
answers.changes_made: I stopped selling both ASINs on 5 March 2026. I obtained a reissued invoice from Bright Wholesale Ltd on 9 March 2026 showing their full address and phone number. I introduced a goods-in log on 10 March 2026 that records the purchase order number against every unit received.
answers.preventive_owner: My warehouse manager, Dele Okafor, checks every inbound delivery against the purchase order on the day it arrives.
